referenceFunction.generalComment: Inventory for 1 MJ heat from natural gas, burned in a cogeneration unit with a capacity of 1 MWth. The multioutput process "natural gas, burned in cogen 1MWth delivers the coproducts "heat, at cogen 1MWth, natural gas, allocation exergy" and "electricity, at cogen 1MWth, natural gas, allocation exergy". The energy efficiency is 41% for electricity and 47% for heat. The exergy factor is 1 for ectricity and 0.170 for heat. This leads to the allocation factor of 0.83 for electricity an 0.17 for heat.; UUID: af0e1a24-c693-364b-bf6e-b9f666f5a9ab
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Included are the natural gas burning in a 1 MWth cogen unit which in turn includes fuel input, infrastructure (boiler), air and water emissions and electrictiy needed for operation. The efficiency and allocation according to exergy is considered
